patterns.assumptions: Assume at least ten distinct cardholders over a 90‑day window; each repayment between £250‑£2,500
patterns.name: Business credit‑card repayments to many individuals
patterns.red_flag_quote: repayments to the credit cards of many different individuals, typically ten or more

patterns.assumptions: Assume at least two money orders per day, combined total <£2,500, repeated on at least two separate days
patterns.name: Multiple small money orders paid in same day
patterns.red_flag_quote: several money orders on the same day whose combined value is just below £2,500

untestable.red_flag: Credit card repayments follow shortly after cash or money order deposits into the same account
untestable.reason: Requires detecting ordered sequence of different transaction types, which cannot be expressed with current pattern fields
